# recall

Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recall my work on X', 'catch me up', 'what have I been working on', 'where did I leave off', before starting or resuming work, and before telling the user that something was never recorded.

Ships in the [`pstack`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Requirements

Requires parallel subagents, Claude Code transcripts in `~/.claude/projects/`, `git`, and the `gh` CLI. Uses the available MCP servers through the `why` skill.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install pstack@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add pstack@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install pstack@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
